title: Lodge a fireworks display notification
summary: Pyrotechnician licence holders can lodge a notification online for using fireworks, distress signals, or model rocket propellant devices.
intro:
Pyrotechnician licence holders need to notify SafeWork NSW at least 7 working days before using fireworks, distress signals (excluding in genuine distress situations) or model rocket propellant devices.

You can lodge your notification online.

Note: You're also required to notify other relevant authorities.
who_can_apply: Single use licence holders are not eligible.
what_you_need: Details of the organisation managing the event (including ABN/ACN)
Confirmation that a risk assessment will be undertaken prior to the event
A current credit card for payment

how_to_steps.text: Log in or create an account.
Follow the prompts to complete your notification.

more_info.text: SafeWork NSW may suspend or cancel your licence, or impose penalties for non-compliance.

faqs.q: How far in advance must I notify SafeWork NSW about using fireworks?
faqs.a: Pyrotechnician licence holders must notify SafeWork NSW at least 7 working days before using fireworks, distress signals, or model rocket propellant devices.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to lodge a fireworks display notification?
faqs.a: You must hold a pyrotechnician licence. Single use licence holders are not eligible.

faqs.q: What do I need to lodge the notification?
faqs.a: You need your licence number and details, event details, supplier details, and confirmation that a risk assessment will be undertaken.
